players.product: Enterprise PCIe and SATA SSDs, RDIMM and CXL DRAM modules for servers, with in-house memory packaging and test (Huizhou) and wafer-level advanced packaging (Dongguan)

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue rose 298.10% YoY, which the report attributes to the AI compute boom and a high-prosperity memory cycle with rising product prices, plus a better product and customer mix; net profit attributable rose 3,273.48% (excluding non-recurring items +2,962.97%) and gross margin reached 54.81% (2025: 21.44%). AI emerging edge storage revenue was about RMB 28.6 hundred million, up 433.58% YoY and 126.98% sequentially, as AI glasses ramped and cooperation with Meta and other key customers deepened.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 15,574,943,371.35 (H1 2025 RMB 3,912,336,913.69, +298.10%); net profit attributable RMB 7,165,580,281.51 (H1 2025 loss RMB 225,795,502.52); excluding non-recurring items RMB 6,632,544,841.00; gross margin 54.81%; AI edge storage about RMB 28.6 hundred million (+433.58% YoY)

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply: the two long-term raw-material purchase contracts with memory makers (names not disclosed) are a US$15 hundred million commitment for a memory wafer product (disclosed March 25, 2026) and a US$18.6080 hundred million commitment for enterprise flash dies (disclosed June 10, 2026), each with locked volume and price over 24 months. Inventory was 54.48% of total assets at June 30, 2026, and prepayments rose 1,252.62% on higher raw-material purchases.
quarterly_data.figure: US$15 hundred million (memory wafers) + US$18.6080 hundred million (enterprise flash), 24 months each; inventory RMB 18,167,509,050.65; prepayments RMB 2,093,913,827.06 (+1,252.62%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Pipeline: the in-house SP9300 UFS 3.1 controller (taped out February 2026) has completed first-silicon verification, with customer introduction planned from H2 2026. Biwin is also designing its own small-capacity NAND with a leading domestic foundry at 24nm/19nm nodes for industrial, automotive and embedded markets: SLC NAND is in first-silicon verification with customer introduction planned from H2 2026, and MLC NAND is under development.
quarterly_data.figure: SP9300 and SLC NAND customer introduction from H2 2026; 24nm/19nm SLC/MLC NAND

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Enterprise storage status: SP-series enterprise PCIe SSDs - SP406/416 in volume shipment, SP50Y/51Y in customer introduction, SP5000 in development; its SP-series enterprise PCIe Gen5 SSDs include TLC models up to 15.36TB and QLC models up to 61.44TB (U.2 and E3.S). SATA SSDs SS811/821 ship in volume and SS831/881 are in customer introduction; the CXL 2.0 DRAM module (up to 256GB) and the RDIMM (up to 6400MT/s, 128GB) are at customer sampling.
quarterly_data.figure: TLC up to 15.36TB; QLC up to 61.44TB; CXL 2.0 module up to 256GB; RDIMM 6400MT/s, 128GB

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Enterprise customers: the company is deepening cooperation with Lenovo and other tier-1 OEMs toward a long-term cooperation framework and advancing business cooperation with internet cloud companies, with volume supply of PCIe SSDs and SATA SSDs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects: the Dongguan wafer-level advanced packaging project (total investment about RMB 30.9 hundred million) had RMB 152,125.22 ten-thousand invested by June 30, 2026 and is in small-batch trial production, with no volume-production revenue yet. The raised-fund Huizhou advanced packaging and memory manufacturing expansion (86.05% invested) is scheduled ready by August 31, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: wafer-level project RMB 152,125.22 ten-thousand invested of RMB 309,000 ten-thousand; Huizhou expansion 86.05% invested

quarterly_data.quarter: Biwin Storage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products: launched the TAU208 automotive UFS 3.1 (23.2Gbps theoretical bandwidth, AEC-Q100 Grade 2) and the M560 PCIe 5.0 SSD (up to 11000MB/s read) for AI PCs, laptops and handheld consoles; its client PCIe Gen5 SSD reached the market with volume delivery at the end of Q1 2026; its automotive UFS is in small-batch sampling and has been introduced at a leading domestic automaker.
